conditions.cache: Fresh browser context per sample; browser cache disabled by CDP; each GLB served with Cache-Control: no-store
conditions.clock: performance.now(): chapter-two entry to all live requested models plus ambient attached
conditions.decode: Attach time minus GLB responseEnd includes parse, image decode, normalization and JavaScript scheduling. The two-RAF checkpoint includes subsequent browser scheduling/rendering; it does not isolate GPU upload time.
conditions.limitation: Cloud SwiftShader/software rendering and emulated network; these are not physical iPhone timings or physical mobile FPS.
conditions.frameScene: Seeded scenery, fixed coat sequence and size1.3; cats held idle by synthetic fixture. Final-model settled positions reused by baseline (asserted within0.005 island units). Five-second frame sample after1.8-second warmup. Unrelated world motion remains active.
conditions.referenceLayout: Actor positions copied from output/playwright/cat-models/performance-high-detail.json for both final and baseline scenes; matching asserted within 0.005 island units.
conditions.coldDefinition: Browser HTTP cache cold; local server and operating-system file cache may already be warm.
conditions.poseLimit: Actor positions, sizes and coat order match; yaw and exact animation time are not reproduced. Chromium process/GPU caches may be warm.
